capabilities: Applies named appearance themes per folder with longest-path matching
Configures width, typography, colors, background, opacity and blur per theme
Adds e-ink mode that grayscales the workspace and removes motion
Builds a dashboard home tab from statistics, field, note, GitHub and Dataview blocks
Shows the active theme name in the status bar
extras: Warns that the dashboard GitHub token is stored in plaintext in data.json and advises a fine-grained read-only token; appearance is applied through CSS variables and a static styles.css, not generated stylesheets.
intentEvidence: Values of 0 or an empty field mean "follow the current Obsidian theme".
problem: Obsidian applies one theme to the whole vault, so different folders cannot have their own reading width, typography, background or e-ink treatment.

relations.evidence: a file from a repository, refreshed on a schedule

summary: Folder-scoped appearance plugin that applies per-folder themes for typography, background, transparency and e-ink, plus a customizable dashboard home tab.
